title: A tower with injective levels and split transitions is injective
statement: Let $I=(I_n,p_n)_{n\geq1}$ be an inverse system [def-weil-inverse-system] of abelian groups in the tower category [lem-pc-tower-abelian]. If every $I_n$ is an injective abelian group [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and every transition map $p_n:I_{n+1}\to I_n$ is a split surjection, then $I$ is an injective object of the tower category.

source.place: Tag 07KW, Lemma 15.88.1 proof footnote (the compatible lifting argument after the split-tower construction)
